F_T1_TOKEN_MESSENGER.baseline_formula: B_e: every tag i remains at X_i with START and lineage multiplicity 1 for all e>=0
F_T1_TOKEN_MESSENGER.name: ENDOGENOUS_LOCAL_SYSTEM_SPANNING_TOKEN_CLOSURE
F_T1_TOKEN_MESSENGER.new_recruit_formula: NEW_RESP_TAG_e={i} exactly when e=q*i for i=0..N-1, with i=0 at e=0
perturbed_formula: tag 0 has lineage multiplicity 2; at e=0 L(X_0)=2 and action H differs from baseline HOLD
for e>=1 tag 0 is at H^e X_0 with current ingress H and continues H
for each i>=1, before e=q*i tag i remains at X_i; at e=q*i messenger and tag i cooccupy X_i so L(X_i)=3 and tag i action changes HOLD->V
for e>=q*i+1 tag i is at V X_i with ingress V and HOLD
F_T1_TOKEN_MESSENGER.post_closure_certificate: after the final recruited tag executes V, tag 0 continues on the finite H orbit with period q*N; all recruited tags i>=1 remain at V X_i. No new participant exists because closure already contains all N tags.
F_T1_TOKEN_MESSENGER.stage_E_reconciliation: Stage-E bound assumed fixed finite T. Here the stationary controller has no T input while the evaluator finds E_*=q(N-1), which grows with N.

F_T2_COOCCUPANCY_WALKER.formula: at e=q*i-1 (i>=1), the H-moving recruited cohort reaches X_i; S_SELF>=2 changes tag i action HOLD->H, so tag i joins the cohort
F_T2_COOCCUPANCY_WALKER.name: ENDOGENOUS_LOCAL_SYSTEM_SPANNING_COOCCUPANCY_CLOSURE
F_T2_COOCCUPANCY_WALKER.post_closure_certificate: all N tags co-move under H on a finite H orbit; paired perturbed state is periodic with period q*N while baseline remains fixed

F_T3_SUPPORT_ONLY_I2_OBSTRUCTION.name: COUNT_MAGNITUDE_REQUIRED_FOR_I2_IN_FROZEN_SUPPORT_GRAMMAR
F_T3_SUPPORT_ONLY_I2_OBSTRUCTION.proof: F-I2 changes exact multiplicity but leaves current relational state and every support bit B_(r) unchanged. Stationarity implies equal action sets at e=0; equal transitions preserve equal support/state inductively. Hence no tag state/support/action delta is generated.
F_T3_SUPPORT_ONLY_I2_OBSTRUCTION.scope: P1 fixed support-bit controllers under F-I2 aligned +1 token

weakest_scope_note: F_T1/F_T2 are constructive existence theorems within the frozen Stage-F grammar; they do not establish uniqueness, physical rigidity, or impossibility of other mechanisms.
